name: Estoril
summary: Portugal's coastal circuit near Lisbon, where Ayrton Senna won his first Grand Prix.
character: A twisty infield, a long main straight and a fast final curve onto it. Strong winds off the Atlantic could change the car's balance.

layouts.name: Final layout
factNotes: From 1994 a slow chicane after the back straight brought the lap to 4.360 km.

moments.title: Senna's first win
moments.body: In heavy rain in 1985, Ayrton Senna won for Lotus by over a minute, in only his second season.

history.body: First race. Niki Lauda won the title there by half a point.
Last Portuguese Grand Prix at Estoril.

leftCalendar: The 1997 race was cancelled when safety upgrades weren't finished in time, and Estoril never came back.
